sql: SELECT count(*) AS labels, sum(CASE WHEN listed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS list_no_establishment, sum(CASE WHEN named = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS name_no_plant, sum(CASE WHEN placed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_plant_placed FROM (SELECT e.set_id, max(CASE WHEN e.source = 'spl_establishment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS listed, max(CASE WHEN e.source IN ('spl_establishment', 'label_text') AND e.establishment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS named, max(CASE WHEN st.duns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS placed FROM fda.spl_establishments e LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT duns FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site) st ON st.duns = e.est_duns GROUP BY e.set_id) t
